Name: Adventures of Captain Becky
Overview:
Adventures of Captain Becky is a puzzle platform game starring the titular female pirate captain. The goal of each stage is to reach the goal as quickly as possible, collecting as much gold as possible, and without dying. Becky can double-jump as well as attack with a mace, which will destroy many but not all hazards and enemies. One hit will kill her, though she can collect a special pink outfit that gives her an extra hit.

There are four difficulties with eight stages each, along with a tutorial. There is also a "gallery mode" where the player can watch Becky dance around in any of the unlocked outfits, as well as an edit mode which provides numerous options for modifying Becky's physique to the player's liking.
